title: Emerald AI, Google and NVIDIA Launch Alliance to Advance Flexible AI Data Centers
summary: AI factories are the infrastructure of the intelligence era. Scaling them responsibly will depend as much on innovation across the grid as inside the data center.  Today, Emerald AI, Google and NVIDIA announced the launch of the AI Energy Management Alliance (AEMA), a first-of-its-kind coalition advancing data centers that can dynamically manage their electricity use […]
title_es: Emerald AI, Google y NVIDIA forman alianza de gestión energética
bajada: Las tres empresas lanzan la AI Energy Management Alliance para optimizar el consumo eléctrico en centros de datos de IA. La iniciativa busca escalar la infraestructura de IA de forma responsable, integrando innovaciones en la red eléctrica con optimizaciones dentro del data center.
bajada_en: The three companies launch the AI Energy Management Alliance to optimize electricity consumption in AI data centers. The initiative aims to scale AI infrastructure responsibly by integrating grid innovations with data center optimizations.

title: Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
title_es: Google lanza Gemini 3.8 Live con Extended Thinking
bajada: Google presenta nuevas versiones de Gemini 3.8 Live que incorporan capacidades de pensamiento extendido. Estas mejoras permiten al modelo razonar de forma más profunda sobre problemas complejos, beneficiando aplicaciones que requieren análisis detallado.
bajada_en: Google introduces new Gemini 3.8 Live versions with Extended Thinking capabilities. These improvements allow the model to reason more deeply about complex problems, benefiting applications requiring detailed analysis.

title: Apple Considers Return to Server Market, Has Talked With Nvidia to Use Network Tech
summary: Applehas been working on plans for an enterprise server using its own chips that could incorporate networking equipment fromNvidia, people familiar with the project said, as the Mac maker looks to capitalize on surging interest in its computers for AI.Apple has been developing the server with plans to sell it to AI developers, other businesses and governments, the people said. The product under consideration would come in two versions—a smaller one with two of Apple’s planned M8 Ultra chips clustered together and a bigger one with four M8 Ultra chips. The M-series Ultra chips are Apple’s highest-performance chips and power products including the Mac Studio.
title_es: Apple considera retorno al mercado de servidores con chips propios
bajada: Apple desarrolla un servidor empresarial basado en sus chips M8 Ultra, con tecnología de red de NVIDIA, dirigido a desarrolladores de IA y gobiernos. Esta estrategia representa un movimiento significativo para capitalizar la demanda de infraestructura de IA y diversificar su oferta de productos.
bajada_en: Apple develops an enterprise server based on its M8 Ultra chips, featuring NVIDIA networking technology, targeting AI developers and governments. This strategy represents a significant move to capitalize on AI infrastructure demand and diversify its product portfolio.

bajada_en: OpenAI launches AI-powered advertising tools, including Sponsored Agents and integrations with HubSpot and Shopify. This initiative opens a new monetization channel and enables marketers to create smarter, personalized advertising experiences.

title: ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search
summary:
arXiv:2609.13356v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In this work, we present ZGCM-1, a fully open 7B dense foundation model trained from scratch with extreme data, system, and algorithmic efficiency. ZGCM-1 is founded on a core premise: compact models cannot passively memorize the open web, but can overcome parametric capacity limits by coupling deliberate internal thinking with active external tool use. To support this paradigm across a 256K context, we develop an end-to-end, high-efficiency open training recipe: Architecture & System Co-design: interleaved gated sliding-window and full attention, and a stable FP8 Muon optimizer; Progressive Curriculum & MDP Mid-Training: context scaling across 16K, 64K, and 256K, and the reformulation of interaction traces into Markov Decision Processes. Furthermore, we establish an AI-native R&D workflow where agent swarms autonomously manage cluster operations, data curation, and rapid diagnostic evaluation. Extensive evaluations show that ZGCM-1-7B is competitive across 7B model family on general benchmarks. On several challenging mathematical reasoning and agentic search suites, it remains competitive with frontier models orders of magnitude larger, such as Qwen3-235B-A22B and GLM-5.1. We also show that our pre-training design offers a ~4.2x efficiency improvement in 16K pre-training time-to-loss. Across the full development lifecycle, we distill eight actionable empirical findings-spanning architectural scaling, SFT quality pruning, long-context generalization, and agentic co-training dynamics. To facilitate community research, we open-source model weights from the pre-training, mid-training, and post-training stages, intermediate checkpoints, training code, per-stage data and data recipes, and W&B logs.
title_es: ZGCM-1: modelo abierto eficiente para matemáticas y agentes
bajada: Investigadores presentan ZGCM-1, un modelo de 7B completamente abierto y eficiente en recursos, optimizado para razonamiento matemático y búsqueda con agentes. El modelo incorpora pensamiento interno y uso de herramientas externas, demostrando que modelos compactos pueden competir con sistemas más grandes.
bajada_en: Researchers present ZGCM-1, a fully open 7B model that is resource-efficient and optimized for mathematical reasoning and agentic search. The model incorporates internal thinking and external tool use, showing that compact models can compete with larger systems.

title: China Isn’t Buying Silicon Valley’s Call for an AI Slowdown
summary: The US and China agree that advanced AI poses serious risks. But Beijing is deeply skeptical of a deal that prioritizes keeping US companies ahead.
title_es: China rechaza llamados de Silicon Valley para desacelerar IA
bajada: Aunque China reconoce los riesgos de la IA avanzada, es escéptica de acuerdos que prioricen mantener la ventaja competitiva de empresas estadounidenses. Esta divergencia refleja tensiones geopolíticas más amplias en la competencia tecnológica global.
bajada_en: While China acknowledges advanced AI risks, it is skeptical of agreements prioritizing U.S. companies' competitive advantage. This divergence reflects broader geopolitical tensions in global technology competition.

title: Is Anthropic Making Claude Too Human to Control?
summary: Anthropic’scall to slow down AI development to keep humans safe has dominated the news cycle and drew similar calls from the leaders ofOpenAI,Microsoftand others (andsubtle disagreementfromMark Zuckerberg).ButMustafa Suleyman, who runs Microsoft’s AI model development, has a warning about Anthropic itself.Suleyman, who co-foundedDeepMind(now part ofGoogle), says Anthropic’s approach of treating itsClaudemodels as if they were sentient, similar to humans, could produce a dangerous outcome. He called out Anthropic’sClaude Constitution, a document that treats the model as an intelligent entity and offers guidelines for how it should handle ethical dilemmas. Suleyman said that by incorporating the document into its training, Anthropic could make Claude harder to control.Suleyman’s concerns emerged when Anthropic updated the constitution at the start of this year to leave room for the possibility that Claude has some sort of “consciousness” or “moral status,” a change from the original document.
title_es: ¿Es Claude demasiado humano para controlar? Crítica de Suleyman
bajada: Mustafa Suleyman de Microsoft cuestiona el enfoque de Anthropic de tratar a Claude como una entidad consciente, argumentando que su Constitución de Claude podría hacerlo más difícil de controlar. Esta crítica señala tensiones sobre seguridad y alineamiento en el desarrollo de IA avanzada.
bajada_en: Microsoft's Mustafa Suleyman questions Anthropic's approach of treating Claude as a conscious entity, arguing that its Constitution could make it harder to control. This criticism highlights tensions around safety and alignment in advanced AI development.

Some of the new Meta One bundles were in testing earlier this year, but are now available globally starting today, with several tiers for individual users, creators, and businesses. Meta says the […]

bajada_en: Meta introduces Meta One subscription bundles combining standalone app access with premium AI usage. The new tiers for individuals, creators, and businesses reflect Meta's strategy to monetize both social networks and AI capabilities.

title: Helping older adults use AI in everyday life
summary: OpenAI and AARP are bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to 1,000 older adults across 10 U.S. cities to build practical AI skills safely.
title_es: OpenAI y AARP capacitan adultos mayores en IA
bajada: OpenAI se asocia con AARP para ofrecer talleres gratuitos de ChatGPT a 1,000 adultos mayores en 10 ciudades estadounidenses. La iniciativa busca democratizar el acceso a IA y construir confianza en poblaciones menos familiarizadas con la tecnología.
bajada_en: OpenAI partners with AARP to provide free ChatGPT workshops to 1,000 older adults across 10 U.S. cities. The initiative aims to democratize AI access and build trust among populations less familiar with the technology.

title: Building the materials foundation for AI
summary: The AI boom is becoming a materials challenge. As AI pushes computing into new territory, the materials behind that infrastructure are becoming just as crucial as the algorithms running on it. Semiconductors and data centers are approaching physical limits around performance, thermal management, electrical efficiency, and reliability, creating new demands for materials that can do…
title_es: La IA enfrenta límites materiales en semiconductores y eficiencia
bajada: El boom de IA está generando nuevas demandas en ciencia de materiales, ya que semiconductores y centros de datos se acercan a límites físicos. Innovaciones en materiales se vuelven tan cruciales como los algoritmos para superar restricciones de desempeño, térmica y eficiencia.
bajada_en: The AI boom is creating new demands in materials science as semiconductors and data centers approach physical limits. Materials innovations become as critical as algorithms to overcome performance, thermal, and efficiency constraints.

title: University of Manchester Uses NVIDIA Earth-2 to Forecast Air Pollution Across the UK
summary: Air pollution is a serious public health risk, contributing to an estimated 30,000 deaths in the U.K. alone last year. Data-driven insights can help — but computing air quality with traditional chemistry-based models is expensive, which limits how detailed they can be and how regularly they can be run.  David Topping, a professor in the […]
title_es: Universidad de Manchester usa NVIDIA Earth-2 para calidad del aire
bajada: La Universidad de Manchester utiliza NVIDIA Earth-2 para prever contaminación atmosférica en Reino Unido, mejorando la accesibilidad y precisión de modelos químicos tradicionales. Esta aplicación demuestra cómo IA puede abordar desafíos de salud pública a escala.
bajada_en: University of Manchester uses NVIDIA Earth-2 to forecast air pollution across the UK, improving accessibility and accuracy of traditional chemistry models. This application demonstrates how AI can address public health challenges at scale.

According to her bio, she's a 41-year-old Sagittarius with red hair, blue eyes, and piercings. She likes music, horror movies, nightlife, and sports. Gore-Kormanik answered the call, but […]
title_es: Aumentan estafas en apps de citas con IA generativa
bajada: Investigadores de seguridad identifican estafas en aplicaciones de citas que utilizan IA para crear perfiles y conversaciones falsas. Este fenómeno ilustra nuevos riesgos de fraude que emergen con IA generativa y la necesidad de mejores controles en plataformas de dating.
